d.ko: Monster Train is a strategic roguelike deck building game with a twist. Set on a train to hell, you’ll use tactical decision making to defend multiple vertical battlegrounds. With real time competitive multiplayer and endless replayability, Monster Train is always on time.

d.zh: 《怪物火车》是一款特别的 Roguelike 卡牌构筑策略类游戏。登上前往地狱的火车，巧妙地运用战术来守卫多个纵向战场。多名玩家实时竞技，无限重玩的游戏机制，《怪物火车》能够随时为您带来欢乐。
